request_recommendations.max_completion_tokens: explicit hard cap; includes thinking tokens
request_recommendations.response_format: Not documented in official OpenAPI request properties; use prompt instructions plus strict local JSON/schema validation unless pilot proves support.

minimax.plan_findings: Current official Token Plan paths redirect to M Plan. Legacy Token Plan may be retained. Subscription Keys and PAYG keys are not interchangeable. Subscription Key uses included quota then any credit packs, not PAYG account balance. Quota has 5-hour and weekly windows. Individual interactive developer use is documented; PAYG recommended for production. Writing/research are documented uses, and no categorical noncoding ban was found, but unrestricted batch production permission was not established. Begin small, stop on exhaustion/throttling; never silently substitute PAYG.
uncertainties: Official terms page redirects to a JS page with no extractable body; old third-party claims about coding-only rules were not treated as authoritative.
Native structured JSON support not promised by fetched schema.
Subscription credit-pack overflow must be checked before treating use as zero incremental spend.

openrouter.important_pricing_units: Public models API prices are USD per token; provider.max_price bounds are USD per MILLION tokens. Pricing can vary by actual provider endpoint.

json_schema.name: dictionary_entries
json_schema.schema: explicit schema, required fields and additionalProperties:false

notes: Check support per endpoint, not only per model. Strict JSON can still require local validation.
Pin explicit model ID and pricing ceiling. No silent model/provider policy fallback.
Optionally add zdr:true, but expect no eligible endpoint rather than weakening privacy policy.
If public corpus may later be used for training, consider enforce_distillable_text:true; absence does not establish training permission.
Reserve worst-case input/output costs before dispatch in one shared ledger; reconcile actual usage and generation cost. Retries and uncertain/time-out requests retain reservation until reconciled.
No full-corpus completion guarantee can be inferred from $23. Measure pilot output, reasoning and checker costs.

licensing.proposed_code_license: MIT for original pipeline code only.
licensing.proposed_data_license: CC BY-SA 4.0 for compatible derived dictionary records, preserving per-record upstream source and original licences; no blanket relicensing of raw sources.
findings: CC BY-SA 3.0 section 4(b) permits adaptations under a later version with the same elements; retain original notices.
Source licence permission and lexical correctness are separate checks.
A headword lead from a restricted source needs independent permissible attestation before entering a public derivative; do not launder a restricted gloss through AI paraphrase.
WordNet packs preserve mixed component licences in WORDNET_NOTICES.txt and wordnet-source.tar.gz. Review them before public export.
Existing machine-translated sources must be marked as such and not counted as independent multilingual proof.
Do not label generated translations as human-reviewed or fully original when based on share-alike source definitions.

pipeline_gates: Read only explicitly provided key paths, never copy keys to public project or print headers.
Keep raw model outputs in a gitignored staging area with request/model/prompt/provenance hashes and actual token usage.
Validate fixed identity/headword/reading and source references; model must not invent sources/readings.
Use independent checker plus evidence agreement; disagreements go to review queue, not accepted manifest.
Public export contains no ND-derived glosses, missing licence dependencies, private logs, credentials or account/quota data.
